name: Gimai to Juumai Tokidoki Tonari no Onee-san
original_name: 義妹と従妹 時々となりのお姉さん
source:
Dumped by my girlfriend, with a sprained right hand and defeated spirits, I came home to be received by a loving little stepsister, loli cousin and older girl next door. They said they'd take good care of me, but come on. Mio was way too young, Kana was a useless otaku and Saori was pregnant.

But I was even more useless, and completely bedridden with no way to jack off... I was grateful for their efforts, but how could I ask them to take care of my lower half?

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ099369.html]DLsite English[/url]]
